column1: # ---- 01-adr/ADR-017 and 01-adr/README.md ----
The Abgrenzungsoption settles on calendar-month aggregates built from quarter-hour MIN and MAX selections and pays through two competing routes.
(11), the storage energy that reached the grid, splits at (6)·pv_share, below which it is green and above which it is grey.
The green/grey split is set by the month's PV-versus-grid charging mix, the aggregate of about 2,880 quarter-hourly decisions each also driven by spot, aFRR, peak and imbalance.
(31) = (30)·(28) with (30) = (29)/(11) is a ratio of decision-dependent monthly sums times a MIN, so it is bilinear and outside the ADR-008 algebra.
The active branch of every MIN is chosen by the optimiser, so a lever's marginal effect has no fixed sign.
Levies are charged on (21) rather than on (3), so the composer's stage-1 precondition that POI energy is fully marked requires stage-2 information.
The MILP carries the seven month-to-date accumulators and their state equations as constraints.
Valuation publishes only the marginal values λ_j = ∂V_del/∂A_j, recomputed every tick.
The accumulator set is A = { (3), (5), (6), (9), (11), (26), (29) }, month-to-date, reset at the Europe/Berlin month boundary.
In-horizon accumulation is A_j = A_j^MTD + Σ over t in H of contribution_j(t).
Everything from (10) to (33) is a closed-form function of A.
V_del is evaluated arithmetically from a projection of the remaining month and is never fitted.
In the grey-present regime ∂(31)/∂(29) = (15)/(11).
In the grey-present regime ∂(31)/∂(11) = −(31)/(11).
In the grey-present regime ∂(31)/∂(6) = (31)/(6).
In the grey-present regime ∂(31)/∂(5) = (31)·(9)/((5)·(10)).
In the grey-present regime ∂(31)/∂(9) = −(31)/(10).

No lever carries a delineation coefficient of its own: curtailment q, charge source, discharge routing, reserve headroom and activation are priced through the accumulator constraints rather than through terms written against them.
V_soc and V_del are separable: V = V_soc(SOC, peakState, qualState) + V_del(delineation coordinates, slotsToMonthEnd).
Separability of V_soc and V_del is permitted because (12) = 0 is assured, which removes the only SOC coupling.
V_del is evaluated per scenario and its risk treatment is the tail of V_del itself, not a per-accumulator sign convention.
Settlement computes the exact delineation machinery, the linearisation lives only in Valuation, and the difference is booked.
SubsidyRevenue is owned by DelineationView on the Delineation base and equals MAX[AW − MW_month; 0] · (32), while spot revenue on the same kWh stays in SpotEnergyValue.
EnfgLevies is owned by DelineationView on the Delineation base and is charged on (21), the reducible EnFG components only.
LeviesAndTaxes is owned by TariffView on the PoiImport base and is narrowed to the non-reducible components, Stromsteuer and Konzessionsabgabe.
There are thirteen economic effects.
The delineation split is a base split and not a relief booked as revenue, so ADR-009 exclusivity holds unchanged.
A new composer stage 3, Delineation, requires battery energy marked and establishes (21).
Composer stage 1 keeps only the non-reducible tariff surface and stays linear.
(12) = 0 whenever monthly charge throughput exceeds η_d·E/(1−η_rt), about 8 charge-equivalent cycles, so Fremdtankstrom vanishes and V_del is separable from SOC; this is asserted, not modelled.
(2)¼ needs no binary when λ_11 ≥ 0, because (11) feeds (13), the base of both routes, and the hypograph relaxation (2) ≤ Z1NE, (2) ≤ Z2E is then tight.
With no grid charging, (9) = 0, the green route is linear because (31) = (29) and the ratio cancels.
All curvature in this design is created by grid charging.
A5 reduces to A1 when all plants are marktprämien-gefördert on a common EEG vintage so that (24x)¼ is common, giving (32x) = ZFx·(32), no per-plant accumulators, and value (32) · Σ_x ZFx·premium_x.
(21) = 0 identically when load = 0 and the connection never clips discharge, because (16)+(19) = (9) = (3); this is held as a settlement test fixture and never as a code path.
Import/export exclusivity requires one binary per slot, because levies penalise import while the premium rewards export and the pair is otherwise unbounded.
(1)¼ = MIN[Z1NB; Z2V] needs a second binary whenever λ_9 may be negative, which is whenever the site has load.
INV-S-10, the zero-gap invariant, is split: modelError gains a linearizationGap sub-bucket comparing L2's λ-linearisation against L5's exact machinery on the same trajectory.
The linearizationGap is expected, budgeted and reported, and residual modelError is still asserted zero.
Without splitting INV-S-10 the most valuable test in L5 fails permanently on day one.
The linearizationGap is interpretable as one thing, projection error.
MW_month is not known at decision time, and because MAX[AW − MW; 0] is convex, pricing at the mean understates the premium.
MW_month is derived per scenario from national spot and national solar generation on the shared scenario axis and is never modelled independently.
An independent MW_month series would destroy the correlation that makes the opposing channels representable, cannibalisation raising the premium while negative-price hours lower (30).
(24)¼ is a state machine and not a comparison, because § 51 and § 51b EEG carry a duration condition, so the indicator for a slot depends on a run of neighbouring day-ahead prices.
The (24)¼ indicator is declared in L1 as a function of the day-ahead series, with the threshold as configuration per EEG vintage.
A kWh discharged into load never enters (11), so self-consumption forfeits both routes.
Because self-consumption forfeiture falls out of the state equations, no SelfConsumptionView is needed.
The negative resolution of self-consumption assumes retail supply is spot-indexed.
A coefficient on q or on reserve headroom must embed the MIN-branch case analysis, evaluated at a state the Planner has not yet chosen.
Raising Z1NB raises (9) only while Z1NB < Z2V, and curtailment eats (2)¼ when Z1NE ≤ Z2E and (23)¼ otherwise, giving four regimes selected inside the same solve.
Attributing energy from PV to battery, battery to grid, or a discharge to a named plant models a fiction.
The delineation evaluates MIN and MAX on four metered scalars per quarter-hour — Z1NB¼, Z1NE¼, Z2V¼, Z2E¼ — and the labels follow with no attribution freedom.
A flow formulation invents degrees of freedom, most damagingly an apparent choice of which plant's AW a discharge earns, which ZF fixes statically, and books value settlement will not pay.
A flow formulation reconciles against nothing the Netzbetreiber records, which is what makes L5 §5.1 a test rather than a second opinion.
C2's vocabulary gains meter-shaped variables only.
An exact formulation to month end is up to 2,880 slots times scenarios per tick with the bilinear terms intact, which is not survivable at C_tick and is forbidden by ADR-008.
Fitting V_del would bake the uncertainty into coefficients instead of leaving it in a projection where it is visible and testable, and would import the staleness machinery for nothing.
A LevyRelief effect double-counts against LeviesAndTaxes unless the base changes too, and relief is not a cashflow.
(20) is reported as a diagnostic quantity.
(21) = 0 is a load-specific identity and not a conservative simplification, so every dual and term built on it is wrong the moment load exists.
The general delineation case is built first rather than scoping v1 to co-location.
Seventeen decisions are expensive to reverse, each recording context, the decision, its consequences, and what was rejected and why.
ADR IDs are stable and referenced throughout the specification.
ADR-001, C# for the engine with the solver behind an abstraction, is Accepted and cheap to reverse.
ADR-002, four clocks with the market calendar as data, is Accepted and moderate to reverse.
ADR-003, typed quantities and two reference frames, is Accepted and expensive later to reverse.
ADR-004, the bitemporal three-tier content-addressed Belief store, is Accepted and very expensive to reverse.
ADR-005, one joint scenario ensemble with a shared scenario axis, is Accepted and very expensive to reverse.
ADR-006, forward within a tick and lagged across ticks via L0, is Accepted and very expensive to reverse.
ADR-007, publishing V(SOC) rather than a scalar λ_SOC, is Accepted and expensive to reverse.
ADR-008, Valuation emitting linearizable primitives rather than prices, is Accepted and very expensive to reverse.
ADR-009, the term ownership matrix with the composer enforcing no double count, is Accepted and moderate to reverse.
ADR-010, the three-tier co-optimisation ladder with a measured gap, is Accepted and moderate to reverse.
ADR-011, the tariff regime as a plug-in with qualification state as a state variable, is Accepted and expensive later to reverse.
ADR-012, the Planner emitting intent with quoting as a separate policy, is Accepted and moderate to reverse.
ADR-013, content-addressed determinism with every artefact replayable, is Accepted and very expensive to reverse.
ADR-014, five named degradation modes with quality driving risk rather than branches, is Accepted and moderate to reverse.
ADR-015, the register of deliberately deferred decisions, is Open.
ADR-016, curtailment as a priced MILP decision and never a rule, is Accepted and moderate to reverse.
ADR-017, delineation as MILP state equations plus marginal values, is Accepted and very expensive to reverse.
Very expensive decisions must be implemented first and correctly, because retrofitting them means rewriting every layer above.
The first two workstreams are the Belief store (ADR-004, ADR-005) and the contract surface (ADR-006, ADR-008, ADR-017), before any economics or optimisation is written.
